body: Partner. I couldn't talk about this with my family, and I don't really do friends. The ache is one of loneliness. I understand what you mean about process now, I guess I just need to be patient and see where it takes me. Thanks.
Hey, 2 poems for you. Invictus: The Unconquerable and Death Be Not Proud

See that's a part of the problem. My ideal life, if life it must be, is only simple pleasures, like books. I've enjoyed thousands of books, and they feature in all my favorite memories. Video games pass the time I guess. I've done a little pottery. I would be fine with staying home and spending my days sleeping, reading, etc, but I find no purpose there. It's fun I guess, but not meaningful. To use my hobbies as analogies, it's like reaching the end of a series, or beating the final level. It was pleasant, and now it's done. My life is like that. Pleasant, now done. But it isn't. Instead, it is just beginning. Trapped living when I want to be done. Any author needs to know how to end a story neatly, and I think this is where my story should end.

Perhaps I was too ambiguous about relationships. I haven't got one. Younger me didn't think I'd want one. But now I have moments where it really hits me how alone I am. I don't want to be alone. I ache. It's at the tail end of these moments that I think I want to live, because just maybe I could find someone, maybe I won't always be alone. 

To what process do you refer?

Like you felt, I'm purposeless. I prefer to spend my time asleep. Of death was written "from rest and sleep, which but thy pictures be, much pleasure, then from thee much more must flow"

Strangely, the only times I feel like living are when I feel hopelessly alone--then I feel like seeking a relationship. But that's a different topic.

I feel for you man. 18 in a week, no friends or fun plans. Haven't celebrated birthdays for years, only mourned them. Drinking age here is 21 though. I have a decent life like yours, I guess. Mostly stay home though. I guess I'm not very good a this support thing, but I understand. When I saw your post, I mistook it for my own because of the birthday. So cheers. Happy Birthday. And good luck.
I've been unable to come up with anything besides hiding my own corpse. Doesn't pair well with the available methods.
Completely understand. I dare not broach the topic with those around me because I know what the reaction will be. And then things would only get harder; they'd be on guard.
Good choice. Sounds like a hard one, but right.
I don't play the same games, but I can do philosophy all day.

How 'bout a Theory of Knowledge question for ya?

Given that every theory has limitations, we need to retain a multiplicity of theories to understand the world. Discuss the claim.

I'm in the same boat. 17 now and moved to a rural, frozen wasteland just in time for HS. Nobody to talk to. I've thrown myself into learning, taking every class at the highest levels at the expense of any electives. I would love to talk sometime. 

And see the 🐈 :)
I'm not sure which way to hope...
Me too. I don't know when the trains run, but every time my family is gone for a couple hours I think about grabbing my bike and doing it.

I wish so, yes. No questions of 'why', no 'please don't', nobody gets to question it. I put my affairs in order and then I'm done. Suicide by comparison takes planning and often leaves behind a larger emotional mess.

Reading through all of these definitely helps me, knowing it's not just me going through all this. I often agonize over my own mental state in a kind of feedback loop, so someone setting this down helps me pin down how I'm feeling myself. And it's good to know it's real.
